new_threads.name: The unrecognized treasure map
new_threads.reason: The party is following a treasure map whose marked locations they do not recognize. Where the treasure lies is still unknown.

new_threads.name: Clurichen from the riverbanks
new_threads.reason: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town from the riverbanks every night, up to no good. The danger stands on its own and is unaddressed.

new_threads.name: Eric the Reeve's dragon bounty
new_threads.reason: Eric offered 1000 gold for the dragon's body (beat_16), and the party has not yet hunted it. Sir Phidipaldi's insult and glove-slap (beats 18-19) soured relations with the bounty-giver, but Eric never accepted the duel, so the duel is not a live thread of its own.

new_threads.name: Lady Hilda's offer to join the dragon hunt
new_threads.reason: Hilda offered to join a party for money to take on the dragon, which gives this thread a stated purpose under the bounty. Sir Phidipaldi said they would speak to the Reeve and come back to take up her services.

new_threads.name: The missing shipments to Brandonsford
new_threads.reason: Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue and its fate is unknown. Farmer Gill adds that nothing has come into town in months, so the question remains open.

new_threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer of hire
new_threads.reason: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for 100 gold a week, with refunds per allowed kill. Dr. Uriah said he would think about it, so the offer stands undecided.

new_threads.name: Shamus the mule
new_threads.reason: Farmer Gill offered to sell Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk asked about trading work for him. Dunk is sleeping in the barn to think the offer over, so it remains undecided.

new_threads.name: Warwick's lucky charms and paranoia
new_threads.reason: Warwick the smith keeps adding lucky charms and growing more paranoid, and it is unclear why. Gill's guess that the charms ward off Ingrid leaves the question open.

new_threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
new_threads.reason: Warwick displays a superb mithril chain shirt that he refuses to sell. It is a desirable item that a normal-sized party member could wear.

new_threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
new_threads.reason: Quinn's stock disappears every night, and he suspects Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for 100 gold to find out what happens, and that help is still owed.

standalone_beats.reason: Bentley banned Sir Phidipaldi from the Clumsy Fox for the night and sent him to the Golden Egg, which split the party's lodging.

shared_subjects.subject: Farmer Gill's three sons already out hunting the dragon
shared_subjects.reason: The sons are rival hunters for the dragon, and the party would deal with them on the dragon hunt.

shared_subjects.subject: No shipments reaching Brandonsford for months
shared_subjects.reason: The question of what happened to the shipments belongs to the thread about the missing shipments, even though Quinn's fake-shipment plan and Warwick's empty stock both depend on it.
